description: Switch a community's governance model. Under a voting model the change goes through a proposal, and passed proposals then wait out governanceConfig.timelockHours (24h by default) before taking effect, during which governanceConfig.objectionThreshold objections (1 by default) hold them permanently. The model lives on the protected community settings record, so the change is governed exactly like any other change to that record: free under benevolent-dictator, and a proposal plus a quorum under simple-majority or on-chain. There is no downgrade ratchet and no admin override.

errors.name: GovernanceDenied
errors.description: The community's current governance model requires this settings change to go through a proposal.

governanceModel.description: Target governance model: benevolent-dictator, simple-majority, or on-chain. on-chain is simple-majority governance plus anchoring: outcomes are decided from voter-signed vote records exactly as under simple-majority, and each decision is additionally notarized through a registered attestor. No outcome depends on a chain read.

governanceConfig.description: Config for the target model (quorum, voterRole, proposalTtlDays, timelockHours, objectionThreshold, chainId, anchoring). timelockHours is the contest window a passed proposal waits out before its change is applied; defaults to 24 when absent, and 0 (immediate application) must be stated explicitly. objectionThreshold is how many countable objections hold that change; it defaults to 1, which means ANY single member holding community.governance.write can veto a passed proposal permanently — a held proposal is never re-reviewed, revoted, or applied, and there is no expiry and no operator override. Raise it to require several objectors. anchoring is { enabled, chainId } and turns external notarization of decisions on or off; on-chain enables it by default from chainId. Anchoring never affects an outcome.
